description: This file contains tests for CanvasWindowController, specifically smoke tests that verify show/hide and show/close functionalities within a macOS application. It uses the XCTest framework and includes test cases that create temporary directories, instantiate controllers, and invoke UI-related methods asynchronously.

classes.name: CanvasWindowSmokeTests
classes.description: A struct containing smoke test cases for verifying CanvasWindowController UI behaviors.

methods.name: panel controller shows and hides
methods.description: Test that a panel controller can show and hide properly, involving creation of a temporary directory, initialization of the controller, and invoking show/hide methods.

methods.name: window controller shows and closes
methods.description: Test that a window controller can show and close properly, involving creation of a temporary directory, initialization of the controller, and invoking show/close methods.
